hard_constraints.end_state_bye_coverage: For every bye week, non-bye players must still cover the mandatory starters at QB, RB, WR, and TE.

fourth_qb.preferred_profile: rookie, uncertain current starter, or high-upside backup with a credible path to starts
fourth_qb.condition: Do not sacrifice the fifth WR, mandatory bye coverage, or a major tier value.

soft_targets.k_dst_timing: Prefer the final three rounds unless a major value or league run changes replacement cost.

bye_penalties.QB: Very high; do not duplicate among the first three.
bye_penalties.WR: Escalate sharply when a bye would leave fewer than three playable WRs.
bye_penalties.RB: Escalate sharply when a bye would leave fewer than two playable RBs.
bye_penalties.TE: Escalate when no playable TE remains.
bye_penalties.overall: Apply an increasing penalty after three rostered players share a bye, but positional coverage is the decisive test.

wr_breakout_signals: expert rank materially above market ADP
rb_contingency_signals: three-down or goal-line ability if promoted
fragility or uncertainty ahead on depth chart
late cost relative to contingency upside
